boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's card_common.c, 0x0205ff70..0x020602bc: 9 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/CARD_common.c defines, in source order, CARDi_SetTask, CARDi_LockResource, CARDi_UnlockResource, CARDi_InitCommon, CARD_IsEnabled, CARD_CheckEnabled, CARD_Enable, CARDi_WaitAsync, CARDi_TryWaitAsync, CARD_GetResultCode, CARD_LockRom, CARD_UnlockRom, CARD_LockBackup, CARD_UnlockBackup. Nine of them are here, each identified by body: CARD_UnlockBackup 0x10, CARD_LockBackup 0x10, CARD_UnlockRom 0x20, CARD_LockRom 0x20 and CARDi_WaitAsync 0x5c at pret's sizes; CARDi_InitCommon 0xb4 (0x100 in pret: no multiboot-child checks, no CARD_Enable), CARDi_UnlockResource 0xa8 (0xa4), CARDi_LockResource 0xa0 (0x9c) and CARDi_SetTask 0x94 (0x48: relative-priority resolution first).

Order: all nine are C, and mwccarm emits deferred C bodies in reverse. The ROM run is exactly pret's source order reversed (CARD_UnlockBackup lowest, CARDi_SetTask highest), with the five functions nothing in this game calls (CARD_IsEnabled, CARD_CheckEnabled, CARD_Enable, CARDi_TryWaitAsync, CARD_GetResultCode) dropped by the linker.
BOTTOM EDGE: PMi_Lock (0x0205ff20..0x0205ff70) and the rest of pm.c (arm9/PM) end at 0x0205ff70; pret's card_common.c has no such function and never touches pm.c's PMi_Work (0x020a8114).

TOP EDGE: CARDi_TaskThread (0x020602bc..0x02060310) is CARDi_TaskThread, the card thread body CARDi_InitCommon creates; in pret it is CARD_request.c, a separate file, with CARDi_OnFifoRecv (CARDi_OnFifoRecv).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/MI_Memory, arm9/OS_SpinLock and arm9/CTRDG_Common: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Every symbol was renamed from its func_ name to the SDK name in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence).
Text-only: cardi_common (cardi_common), cardi_arg (cardi_arg) and cardi_thread_stack (ends at data_020a8760) stay externs. The file claims no data.
CARDi_LockResource / CARDi_UnlockResource are static in pret; here they keep external linkage like every other arm9 symbol, and they stay out of line either way.
